scope: Independent review of theory, empirical claim scope, statistics interpretation and source portability. No new prediction or query-GT access.
substantive_corrections_verified: Latest repository snapshot separated from old checkout; D1/T2 completed experiments no longer called unrun.
Four input/information layers separated: RGB, frozen representation/internal computation, algorithm relations, additional query GT.
GT-selected good masks demonstrate candidate availability only; no inference that legal inputs identify them.
Pixel 0-1 Bayes prior and threshold separated from class-summed IoU objective and predicted-set size.
RePRI meta-training/batched-query description corrected using the primary paper.
Cross-episode training distinguished from episode-local fitting; supervised rank probe is not a zero-training result or full-representation capacity bound.
RCG universal unary ceiling separated from actual all-negative components and bilinear pixel certificates.
RCG theorem explicitly requires lambda>=0; isolated-node propagation and h=1 undefined LOO are handled.
Binary mincut and LOO RandomState supplemental CIs identified; original default_rng results preserved.
Singleton-class multiplicity cancellation explained as correct for class-summed I/U; old episode-mean bootstrap identified as another estimand.
Postprocessing improvement is effective use of existing evidence, not evidence that the pretrained model acquired new recognition ability.
Failures constrain tested construction, summaries, decoder and cohort, not RGB or full pretrained representation.
Current criterion stable >=2 versus final native retained; CI crossing zero alone is not failure.
limits: This review did not reproduce all historical experiments or inspect unprovided local Opus code.
The stated class-held-out ranker is supervised on exposed old120; bootstrap holds fitted OOF predictions fixed and excludes model-refitting uncertainty.
No additional100/121 query labels were opened.
